units.source_text: 这样看不起女人的我，却无论如何也不能看不起小姐，我的逻辑在她面前根本无用武之地。

en.t: Although I was a man who looked down on women in this way, I could by no means look down on the young lady; my logic was utterly useless in her presence.

units.source_text: 我对她怀着近乎崇拜的爱。

en.t: I felt for her a love that was almost worship.

units.source_text: 我把这种只适用于宗教的词语用在年轻女人身上，可能会使你惊讶，但我至今仍然深信不疑。

en.t: It may surprise you that I apply to a young woman a word that belongs only to religion, but even now I remain firmly convinced of it.

units.source_text: 我坚信真正的爱与宗教信仰并没有什么不同。

en.t: I firmly believe that true love is not essentially different from religious faith.

units.source_text: 每当我看到小姐的面容，就会觉得自己也变得美好起来，每当想到小姐，不由得感觉自己顿时变得超凡脱俗。

en.t: Whenever I saw the young lady's face, I felt that I too became better; whenever I thought of her, I could not help feeling that I had suddenly risen above the ordinary world.

units.source_text: 假如爱这个神奇的东西有两端，那高的一端是神圣感，低的一端是性欲在起作用的话，那么我的爱是立足于高的一端的。

en.t: If the mysterious thing called love has two ends, with a sense of holiness at the higher end and sexual desire at work at the lower end, then my love stood on the higher end.

units.source_text: 作为人，我原本是个脱离不了肉欲的凡胎，但我面对小姐时的眼睛、思念小姐时的心情，却丝毫没有肉欲的气息。

en.t: As a human being, I was of course a mortal body unable to escape carnal desire, but the eyes with which I faced the young lady and the feelings with which I thought of her had not the slightest trace of sensuality.
